About Me

Hey, I'm Kenn

I'm a Canberra-based photographer and videographer who's spent the last few years creating in-depth UGC and brand content for high-end outdoor and lifestyle brands. That same eye for light, composition, and detail is what I now bring to real estate — treating every listing with the same care I'd put into a brand campaign, so the space looks like somewhere people actually want to walk into.

Why Work With Me

  • Fast, reliable turnaround — every set delivered within 24–48 hrs, no chasing required.
  • Clear communication from booking through delivery — you always know where things stand.
  • Consistent quality shoot to shoot, so every listing looks as strong as the last.
  • Easy to book, easy to work with — flexible around your prep timeline, no back-and-forth needed.

Every listing shot and edited with the same care I'd put into a brand campaign.
